newsitem.title: USA: Spier says has financing for Video Lottery.
newsitem.headline: Spier says has financing for Video Lottery.

text.p: New York investor William Spier on Wednesday presented a letter to Video Lottery Technologies Inc assuring the company that he has the financing to buy it for $6 a share.
Spier said in the letter that he has satisfied all reasonable concerns of the company's board and special committee and that financing for the deal and all regulatory approvals will be obtained.
Spier, who is a director of Video Lottery, holds about 2.5 percent of the company's stock and heads a group with about 14.4 percent.
Spier also is offering to buy another 20 percent of the company's shares for $6 a share immediately upon signing of a merger agreement.
"I'm prepared to show my credibilty and ability to get this transaction done by putting money on the table at the time of the agreement," Spier said in an interview.
Video Lottery shares rose 1/4 Wednesday afternoon to 4-1/8.
